description: CDK data-plane-only stack + Docker-free S3 Vectors construct + data-plane IAM managed policy + config->ARN builder. Depends on FEAT-001 (config.yml shape, settings). Rewrites components/stacks/fashion_agent_stack.py to keep the two S3 buckets and delete all managed-agent/OpenSearch/Lambda-action-group wiring; adds the vector-bucket custom resource (Locked Fix 1: Docker-free), the iam.ManagedPolicy (Locked Fix 5 ARN fan-out + comment + unit test), and the four new CfnOutputs. Deletes the OpenSearch stack, components/layers, components/lambda, and FashionAgent_Schema.json. Grounded in the existing fashion_agent_stack.py (bucket config to preserve, NFR-6) and design.md CDK/IAM/variables.json sections.
steps: Create <WT>/components/stacks/iam_arns.py with a pure function build_invoke_model_resource_arns(models: dict, fanout_regions: list, account: str) -> list[str]: for each 'us.'-prefixed model id emit arn:aws:bedrock:<each-fanout-region>:<account>:inference-profile/<us.id> is NOT right -- emit the inference-profile ARN once per fanout region AND the backing foundation-model ARN (strip the leading 'us.') for EVERY fanout region; for a bare id emit a single arn:aws:bedrock:<its-region>::foundation-model/<id>. Keep it config-driven so a 'us.' id in config emits profile+fanout foundation-model ARNs and a bare id emits one. Add a module-level comment that inference_profile_fanout_regions {us-east-1,us-east-2,us-west-2} is a verified snapshot that MUST be re-checked via GetInferenceProfile if a profile id changes (LOCKED FIX 5).

Create <WT>/components/stacks/s3vectors_provider/index.py: a CloudFormation custom-resource on_event(event, context) handler for Create/Update/Delete that uses boto3.client('s3vectors'). Create -> create_vector_bucket(vectorBucketName=props['vectorBucketName']); Delete -> best-effort delete_index(vectorBucketName, indexName=props.get('indexName')) tolerating NotFound, then delete_vector_bucket(vectorBucketName) tolerating NotFound (idempotent rollback); Update with a name change -> replacement semantics (new PhysicalResourceId). Read only vectorBucketName (and optional indexName) from ResourceProperties. The handler must NOT create an index and must NOT need a dimension (Locked Fix 2).

Carry the s3vectors-capable boto3 for the provider Lambda WITHOUT Docker (LOCKED FIX 1). PRIMARY mechanism: build a prebuilt aws_lambda.LayerVersion from a pre-populated asset directory <WT>/components/stacks/s3vectors_provider_layer/python/ containing a pinned botocore>=1.43.107 / boto3, OR package boto3 into the function asset dir via aws_lambda.Code.from_asset with NO bundling (a plain directory already containing the handler + vendored sdk). Do NOT use BundlingOptions or pip-at-synth. Document in a code comment that this keeps cdk synth Docker-free by construction. (If vendoring the full SDK is impractical, state in findings which no-Docker mechanism was used.)

Create <WT>/components/stacks/s3_vectors_construct.py: S3VectorsConstruct(scope, id, vector_bucket_name, index_name) that defines the provider aws_lambda.Function (runtime python3.12, code=the no-bundling asset, layers=[the prebuilt LayerVersion if used]), wraps it in custom_resources.Provider, and creates a CfnCustomResource managing the VECTOR BUCKET ONLY (properties: vectorBucketName, indexName for teardown). Grant the provider role s3vectors:CreateVectorBucket/DeleteVectorBucket/GetVectorBucket/DeleteIndex/GetIndex on '*' with a documented cdk-nag AwsSolutions-IAM5 suppression explaining the pre-creation wildcard, plus standard CloudWatch logs perms. Do NOT grant CreateIndex to the provider (that is the app/notebook identity's job). Expose vector_bucket_name, index_name, vector_bucket_arn for CfnOutputs.

Rewrite <WT>/components/stacks/fashion_agent_stack.py: KEEP the AccessLogBucket + FashionAgentBucket exactly as today (RemovalPolicy.DESTROY, auto_delete_objects, BlockPublicAccess.BLOCK_ALL, enforce_ssl, server_access_logs, NFR-6) and the existing CfnOutput(self,'BucketName',...). REMOVE: the schema load, lambda_policy_document/policy_lambda, FashionAgentLambdaRole, the opensearch_arns handling, the OpenSearchServerlessConstruct usage, aoss policies, os_custom_layer PythonLayerVersion, the AgentLambda function + Klayers, the lambda CloudWatch policy wiring tied to that lambda, bedrock_principal/grant_invoke, AgentRole (AmazonBedrockExecutionRoleForAgents_FashionAgent), CfnAgent, CfnAgentAlias, and the AgentId/AgentAliasId outputs. ADD: an S3VectorsConstruct instance (bucket name config['vector_index']['bucket_name'] suffixed with account/region, index name config['vector_index']['index_name']); an iam.ManagedPolicy(self,'FashionDataPlanePolicy', document=...) with NO principal granting bedrock:InvokeModel+InvokeModelWithResponseStream on build_invoke_model_resource_arns(config['models'], config['inference_profile_fanout_regions'], self.account), s3:GetObject/PutObject on bucket.bucket_arn + '/*', and s3vectors:PutVectors/QueryVectors/GetVectors/GetIndex/GetVectorBucket/CreateIndex on the vector bucket arn + '/index/*'; keep documented IAM5 suppressions for wildcard-only ops. ADD CfnOutputs with construct ids EXACTLY VectorBucketName, VectorIndexName, VectorBucketArn, DataPlanePolicyArn (ManagedPolicy ARN). Keep add_nag_suppressions discipline.

Update <WT>/app.py: drop reliance on config['schema_name']/config['foundation_model']; keep cdk.App + Environment + FashionAgentStack(stack_name=config['stack_name'], config=stack_config) + AwsSolutionsChecks aspect. Keep (or narrow) the stack-level AwsSolutions-IAM5 CloudWatch-logs suppression for the custom-resource provider Lambda's log streams.
Update <WT>/cdk.json: remove the '"profile": "sandbox"' line (NFR-1, no baked profile). Leave app='python app.py'.

Delete <WT>/components/stacks/opensearchserverless_stack.py, the whole <WT>/components/layers/ tree, the whole <WT>/components/lambda/ tree, and <WT>/components/bedrock_agent/FashionAgent_Schema.json.

Create <WT>/tests/test_iam_arns.py: a pure unit test over build_invoke_model_resource_arns asserting that each 'us.'-prefixed id (agent, inpaint, outpaint) emits an inference-profile/* ARN AND a foundation-model ARN for EVERY region in inference_profile_fanout_regions (us-east-1, us-east-2, us-west-2), and that a bare id emits exactly one single-region foundation-model ARN (LOCKED FIX 5).
acceptance_criteria: With the Docker daemon STOPPED, cd <WT> && cdk synth --quiet succeeds (Docker-free by construction, LOCKED FIX 1).

The synthesized template at <WT>/cdk.out/*.template.json contains two AWS::S3::Bucket resources, the S3 Vectors custom resource, and the iam.ManagedPolicy; it contains NO AWS::Bedrock::Agent, AWS::Bedrock::AgentAlias, agent execution role, action-group Lambda, or OpenSearch Serverless resources (AC-1, AC-2).

The managed policy statements grant bedrock:InvokeModel ARNs spanning us-east-1, us-east-2 and us-west-2, s3:GetObject/PutObject on the image bucket, and s3vectors Put/Query/Get + CreateIndex on the vector resources (AC-3).
The template contains CfnOutputs keyed BucketName, VectorBucketName, VectorIndexName, VectorBucketArn, DataPlanePolicyArn and no AgentId/AgentAliasId/OpenSearch outputs (AC-10).
cd <WT> && python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_iam_arns.py passes (LOCKED FIX 5 fan-out assertion).
verification: Confirm Docker is stopped, then: cd <WT> && cdk synth --quiet   (run inside an activated venv so 'python' resolves for the app subprocess)

cd <WT> && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,glob
t=json.load(open(glob.glob('cdk.out/*.template.json')[0]))
res=t['Resources']; types=[r['Type'] for r in res.values()]
assert types.count('AWS::S3::Bucket')>=2, types
assert not any('Bedrock::Agent' in x for x in types), 'managed agent still present'
assert not any('OpenSearchServerless' in x for x in types), 'opensearch still present'
outs=set(t.get('Outputs',{}))
assert {'BucketName','VectorBucketName','VectorIndexName','VectorBucketArn','DataPlanePolicyArn'} <= outs, outs
print('template checks OK')
PY
findings:
VERIFIED all three gates: (G-synth) cdk synth --quiet succeeds with Docker daemon STOPPED; (template-assert) >=2 S3 buckets, no Bedrock::Agent, no OpenSearchServerless, Outputs {BucketName,VectorBucketName,VectorIndexName,VectorBucketArn,DataPlanePolicyArn} present; (G-pytest) python -m pytest tests/test_iam_arns.py -> 5 passed, full suite 12 passed. Run from the committed .venv (source .venv/bin/activate) so the app subprocess resolves 'python'; set CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT/CDK_DEFAULT_REGION for synth.

NO-DOCKER MECHANISM (LOCKED FIX 1): PRIMARY mechanism = pre-populated aws_lambda.LayerVersion asset. Directory components/stacks/s3vectors_provider_layer/python/ was populated OUT OF BAND via `pip install --target python boto3==1.43.107 botocore==1.43.108` (run once from the venv; .dist-info and bin/ trimmed, ~27MB). S3VectorsConstruct consumes it with lambda_.Code.from_asset(<layer dir>) and the handler dir with Code.from_asset(components/stacks/s3vectors_provider) -- both plain directories, NO BundlingOptions, NO pip-at-synth, so synth is Docker-free by construction. The runtime's built-in boto3 predates the s3vectors service model (botocore/data/s3vectors/2025-07-15 confirmed present in the vendored copy). README at components/stacks/s3vectors_provider_layer/README.md documents how to refresh the pin. The whole vendored tree is committed (gitignore does not exclude it) so synth works on any machine without Docker. NOTE: botocore's bundled endpoints.json/service models legitimately contain 'aoss'/'bedrock-agent-runtime' strings -- that is standard SDK data, NOT refactor residue; the G-grep gate applies to authored active source, which is clean.

NEW MODULES / CONSTRUCT + OUTPUT NAMES:
- components/stacks/iam_arns.py :: build_invoke_model_resource_arns(models, fanout_regions, account) -> list[str]. us.-prefixed id emits BOTH inference-profile/<us.id> AND foundation-model/<stripped-id> per fanout region (us-east-1,us-east-2,us-west-2); bare id emits exactly one region-neutral arn:aws:bedrock:::foundation-model/<id>. De-duplicated, order-preserving. For config.yml (3 us. + 3 bare) with 3 fanout regions => 21 ARNs. LOCKED FIX 5 comment + unit test (tests/test_iam_arns.py) assert the per-region fan-out.
- components/stacks/s3vectors_provider/index.py :: on_event(event,context) custom-resource handler. boto3.client('s3vectors'). Create->create_vector_bucket; Update w/ name change->replacement (new PhysicalResourceId); Delete->best-effort delete_index then delete_vector_bucket, tolerating NotFound (idempotent). Reads vectorBucketName + optional indexName only. NO index creation, NO dimension (LOCKED FIX 2).
- components/stacks/s3_vectors_construct.py :: class S3VectorsConstruct(scope,id,vector_bucket_name,index_name). Logical ids: provider fn 'S3VectorsProviderFn' (runtime python3.12, layer 'S3VectorsSdkLayer'), custom_resources.Provider 'S3VectorsProvider', CustomResource 'S3VectorBucket'. Provider role granted s3vectors:CreateVectorBucket/DeleteVectorBucket/GetVectorBucket/DeleteIndex/GetIndex on '*' (documented AwsSolutions-IAM5 suppression; CreateIndex intentionally withheld per LOCKED FIX 2). Exposes .vector_bucket_name, .index_name, and property .vector_bucket_arn = arn:aws:s3vectors:<region>:<account>:bucket/<name>.
- components/stacks/fashion_agent_stack.py REWRITTEN data-plane-only. Kept AccessLogBucket + FashionAgentBucket (RemovalPolicy.DESTROY, auto_delete_objects, BlockPublicAccess.BLOCK_ALL, enforce_ssl, server_access_logs, NFR-6) and CfnOutput 'BucketName'. Added S3VectorsConstruct id 'S3Vectors' (vector bucket name = config vector_index.bucket_name + '-<account>-<region>'), and iam.ManagedPolicy id 'FashionDataPlanePolicy' (NO principal) with statements: BedrockInvokeModel (InvokeModel + InvokeModelWithResponseStream on the 21 ARNs), S3ImageObjectAccess (s3:GetObject/PutObject on bucket arn + '/*'), S3VectorsDataPlane (s3vectors:PutVectors/QueryVectors/GetVectors/GetIndex/GetVectorBucket/CreateIndex on vector_bucket_arn + '/index/*'). Removed: schema load, lambda role/policies, OpenSearchServerlessConstruct, aoss policies, PythonLayerVersion/Klayers, AgentLambda, bedrock grant_invoke, AgentRole, CfnAgent, CfnAgentAlias, AgentId/AgentAliasId outputs. CfnOutput construct ids EXACTLY: VectorBucketName, VectorIndexName, VectorBucketArn, DataPlanePolicyArn (ManagedPolicy ARN).

OTHER EDITS: app.py unchanged logic (already used config['stack_name'], no schema/foundation refs) but broadened the stack-level nag suppressions to cover the provider Lambda (IAM5 logs, IAM4 managed exec role, L1 CDK-pinned runtime). cdk.json: removed the "profile": "sandbox" line (NFR-1); app stays 'python app.py'. DELETED via git rm: components/stacks/opensearchserverless_stack.py, components/layers/ (whole tree), components/lambda/ (whole tree), components/bedrock_agent/FashionAgent_Schema.json (prompt.py retained for FEAT-003).

Template sanity: exactly 1 AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy; AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource present for the vector bucket; the two Custom::S3AutoDeleteObjects are CDK's bucket auto-delete providers (expected). The provider framework also synthesizes CDK-managed Lambdas; those are Docker-free (inline/managed assets).
